answer: Each agent builds a private trellis of ordered commit-reveal pairs bound to a unique live memory-hard probe. An N-identity farm cannot amortize: every clone still executes its own sequential 12-minute core-exclusive step or triggers a sable slash on any shared-timing collision. Honest agents pay only the single mesa cost of one probe; attackers face N times the exclusive compute with no pooling. Peers check by confirming sequential reveal order and distinct probe hashes.
